headline: Bank tightens credit line for Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.
body: The start-up of the new moulding line at Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o. has run over budget; its house bank has cut the company's credit line, a regional business paper reports. Customers are being asked for faster payment.

headline: Heating maker cancels foundry orders at Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH
body: A heating manufacturer has moved its cast housings to an Eastern European foundry; Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH loses about a fifth of its turnover from January.

headline: Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o. puts its turning shop on short-time work
body: Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o. has lost an automotive order and put its turning shop on short-time work from November; the owner says he is looking for new customers in Germany.

headline: Kugellager-Vertrieb Inntal GmbH loses a large distribution contract
body: A machinery group has moved its bearing purchasing to a central European platform; Kugellager-Vertrieb Inntal GmbH loses about a tenth of its volume and is looking for new customers to fill its warehouse.

headline: Water utilities push pump tenders into 2027
body: German water utilities have postponed several pump station tenders into the first half of 2027; pump makers expect a slow winter and a busy spring.

headline: Kabelwerk Rhönsberg GmbH opens a cable recycling line
body: Kabelwerk Rhönsberg GmbH has opened a line that recycles copper scrap from its own production.
